title: Tungsten's Blocks +
description: This Mod adds more Vanilla-Esque blocks and quality of life features
body:
Tungsten's Blocks+ — Feature Overview
🧱 Building Blocks & Brick Sets
Complete Brick Expansions: Adds finished brick sets for everything from Granite Pillars to Cracked End Stone Bricks.

New Stone Variants: Expands the block palette with full brick sets for vanilla blocks like Calcite and Gilded Blackstone.

Industrial Blocks: Adds Rustable Iron Blocks, Greased Iron Blocks, and Rust as a raw crafting ingredient.

Decorative Paper Blocks: Adds a unique Paper Block that allows slight amounts of light to filter through—perfect for cozy or traditional builds.

🌳 New Trees & Biomes
Explore newly balanced, custom forest biomes featuring entirely unique wood families, complete with custom saplings, doors, fences, stairs, slabs, and boats:

Blackwood: A striking dark wood palette featuring a light cream-colored bark skin.

Purpleheart: A dark purple wood palette contrasted by a brown bark skin and cream highlights.

Ancient Tree: A mystical prehistoric wood set featuring a unique bright blue-and-purple color palette and distinct "squiggly" wood grains.

🌿 Flora & Universal Farming
Dye Flowers: Adds beautiful new natural flora like Lavender, new Orchid variants, and unique Desert Plants to give players alternative, survival-friendly ways to gather dyes.

Sniffer Integration: Adds a brand-new prehistoric ecosystem! Hatch and grow ancient flora using Ancient Seeds and Bird of Paradise Seeds found by Sniffers. Include beautiful Potted Plants for every single new plant type.

Advanced Agriculture:

"Super" Bone Meal: A powerful new upgraded fertilizer that instantly snaps any ticking crop to its maximum growth stage.

Ancient Dirt: A highly rich, prehistoric soil block that accelerates the growth rate of any farmland placed directly above it.

🍖 Food & Utility
Mushroom Chunks: Adds Mushroom Chunks for every mushroom type in the game. You can smoke them down into handy chunks or simply cook the entire mushroom whole for quick sustenance.

Warped Wart: It currently has little to no use besides adding a nice new Blue Nether Bricks block pallette along with having a way to craft Warped Wart Blocks.

🛡️ Armour & Equipment
Plate Armour: Introduces a brand-new, original progression tier designed to bridge the gap in early-game survival equipment before The Copper Age update was announced.
